welcome.headline: Read it. Play it. See how it went.
welcome.body: Real music, a few bars at a time. We listen while you play and show you every note.
onboarding.mic.title: Let the app hear you play
onboarding.mic.body: We listen while you play so we can mark each note. Sound is analysed on this device. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
onboarding.level.placement: Find my difficulty ({count} short pieces, about {minutes} minutes)
onboarding.calibration.iosNote: On iPhone and iPad, tries earn XP only after this check.
calibrate.intro: Your speakers and mic add a small delay. We'll measure it so "late" really means late.
calibrate.loopback.success: Your setup adds {ms} ms. We'll correct for it.
calibrate.audibility.question: Can you hear the click clearly while you play a note?
calibrate.audibility.hint: Try the Woodblock or Beep sound, or wired headphones.
calibrate.fail.estimate: Timing can't be trusted with an estimate, so tries won't earn XP until you calibrate.
calibrate.warn.bluetooth: This looks like Bluetooth audio, which can add a lot of delay. Wired headphones or built-in speakers usually work better.
calibrate.warn.delay: Your audio has a long delay ({ms} ms), so tries won't earn XP for now. Practice works as usual. If you use wireless headphones, wired ones usually help.
calibrate.warn.airpods: AirPods microphones reduce accuracy. Use the iPhone mic.
calibrate.warn.aec: Your device seems to be filtering the microphone, which can hide quiet notes and blur timing.
calibrate.check.sanityTone.fail: The tone came back out of tune, so the sound may be resampled on its way. Close other apps that play sound, then reload the page.
calibrate.check.clicksHeard.fail: Too few clicks reached the mic to time them. Turn the volume up and run it again.
calibrate.check.countInRecheck.fail: A count-in didn't match the measured delay. Run it again in a quiet room.
calibrate.check.clockRate.fail: Your device's audio clock seems to run at the wrong speed, which can blur timing. Close other apps that play sound, then reload the page.
calibrate.check.micProcessingOff.fail: The browser is changing the mic sound (echo or noise reduction), which can hide quiet notes. Try another browser or input.
calibrate.check.screenRefresh.fail: The screen drew slowly, so marks may lag. Close other tabs and apps.
calibrate.check.notRun.headphones: Needs the speakers, so it doesn't run with headphones.
calibrate.check.notRun.noProbe: Not measured in the browser yet.
calibrate.check.notRun.unmeasured: We couldn't get a steady reading this time. It doesn't affect your result.
calibrate.preview.loopback: About {seconds} seconds: clicks at uneven gaps (on purpose, so an echo can't fool the timing), a short tone, then a one-bar count-in. Stay quiet until it ends.
calibrate.preview.playAlong: About {seconds} seconds: {clicks} steady clicks. Play one short note on each.
calibrate.preview.headphones: With headphones, sound doesn't reach the mic, so there's no tone or count-in check.
calibrate.stage.timing.detail: {clicks} ticks at uneven gaps, on purpose
calibrate.stage.countIn.detail: one loud click, then {soft} softer, like a count-in
calibrate.stage.playAlong.detail: {clicks} clicks, play a short note on each
calibrate.result.meaning.loopback: That's how long a sound takes to leave your speakers and reach the mic. We take it off every note you play, so early and late are fair.
calibrate.result.meaning.playAlong: That's the delay between a click and hearing your note. We take it off every note you play, so early and late are fair.
calibrate.fail.loopback.few: We heard {found} of {total} ticks, not enough to time them. Turn up the volume, or play along instead.
calibrate.fail.loopback.spread: The ticks came back at uneven delays, so the timing can't be trusted. Close other apps that play sound, then try again.
calibrate.fail.loopback.range: The delay was outside what we can use. Try again, or play along instead.
scan.cover: Take a moment to read before you play. Keep your eyes ahead. Every mark waits for you after the try.
scan.ranked.notice: You'll have {seconds} seconds to read, then the count-in starts by itself. Want more time? Switch to Practice.
scan.overflow.aboutMusic: About this music (shows title and composer)
scan.wakeLockHint: Set Auto-Lock to Never while you practise (Settings > Display & Brightness).
scan.tuning.result: You're {cents} cents {direction}. We'll allow for that.
scan.windowTooShort: Make the window taller to see the next line
stars.tempo.prompt: Feel how fast one beat is. Press Hear the tempo if you like.
play.status.noSignal: We can't hear you. Move closer to the mic?
play.status.lostPlace: Lost your place? Rejoin at the next bar line.
play.status.comeIn: Keep going: come in at bar {n}
play.stopConfirm.ranked.afterNote: Stop now? This try will be scored as it stands.
play.stopConfirm.practice: Stop this try? Stopped practice tries aren't scored.

reference.info.voice: This is your reference. It's the key of the piece: you hear its home chord, then the first note you'll sing. Find your pitch from there. We mark your pitch relative to this start, in any octave that suits your voice. It also plays just before the count-in; you can turn that off in Settings.
